item.title: Australia Drafts Law Mandating Independent Safety Audits for Frontier AI Models
item.description:
Australia's Albanese government unveiled its first mandatory safety law for frontier AI models, requiring developers to submit to independent audits, run continuous safety checks, publish safety frameworks, and report incidents immediately. A new oversight body will enforce compliance alongside the Australian AI Safety Institute with steep penalties, with details to follow public consultation.

原文标题：澳大利亚拟立法强制前沿模型接受独立安全审计

Why it matters：这是主要经济体首次以立法形式强制前沿模型开放独立审计，对全球 AI 监管走向与厂商合规成本有直接参考价值。

item.title: SMIC Net Profit Jumps 91.6% to 7.31 Billion Yuan in First Nine Months
item.description:
SMIC reported 60.62 billion yuan in revenue and 7.31 billion yuan in net profit for the first nine months of 2026, up 22.4% and 91.6% year over year, driven by higher wafer shipments, rising utilization and an improved product mix. Third-quarter revenue reached 21.98 billion yuan with net profit of 2.85 billion yuan, as utilization climbed above the prior quarter's 93.7% and 12-inch wafers rose to 78.9% of mix.

原文标题：中芯国际前三季净利 73.14 亿元同比增 91.6%

Why it matters：中国大陆最大晶圆代工厂盈利接近翻倍，产能利用率与 12 英寸占比走高，是观察本土 AI 算力供给底座的关键财务信号。

item.title: Huawei Cloud to Unveil CloudRobo Embodied World Model on November 16
item.description:
Huawei Cloud has scheduled an online launch on November 16 for CloudRobo-WM1.2, the first Ascend-native world model under its Industry AI Dream Factory platform. The model targets embodied intelligence scenarios, consistent with Huawei Cloud's strategy of building platforms and models rather than robot hardware. Only the name and date have been disclosed so far, with no technical details yet.

原文标题：华为云 CloudRobo 世界模型定档 11 月 16 日发布

Why it matters：昇腾原生世界模型首次落地具身智能平台，是观察国产算力与世界模型路线的重要节点。

item.title: Dubai Billionaire Says OpenAI and Anthropic Bets Yield Billions
item.description:
DAMAC founder Hussain Sajwani said at Bloomberg's Dubai investment forum that his stakes in OpenAI, SpaceX and Anthropic alone have earned billions of dollars, with his net worth now above $13 billion. He acknowledged valuation pullback risk, while Blackstone flagged digital infrastructure and compute demand as prime opportunities and PIMCO expected digital infrastructure lending growth to slow.

原文标题：迪拜富豪称投资 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 获利数十亿美元

Why it matters：反映中东资本对头部 AI 公司的押注回报与估值分歧，是观察 AI 资产泡沫争论的一手信号。

item.title: South Korea Unveils 40 Million Dollar Edge AI Chip Roadmap for 2030
item.description:
South Korea's Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy unveiled a roadmap for edge AI semiconductor development, committing 800.2 billion won (about 400 million yuan) to complete development and validation of 10 AI chips by 2030. The chips target smart appliances, autonomous driving, collaborative and humanoid robots, agricultural robots, drones, plus advanced-node and extreme-environment projects, with Samsung and other foundries prioritizing MPW tape-out slots and IP vendors cutting design costs.

原文标题：韩国投 40 亿元推进端侧 AI 芯片 2030 年验证 10 款

Why it matters：国家级端侧 AI 芯片路线图落地，涉及代工产能与 IP 成本机制，是观察 AI 算力供应链区域化的重要信号。

item.title: Foxconn Warns Chip and Memory Shortages to Persist Through 2027
item.description:
Foxconn chairman Young Liu said AI demand will continue to outstrip supply in 2027, with tight chip, memory and key component availability persisting even as new capacity gradually comes online. He expects AI cloud products to exceed 60% of Foxconn's revenue within three to five years, while taking a cautious view of PCs as memory-driven price hikes may dampen upgrade demand.

原文标题：鸿海预警 2027 年芯片与内存供需持续吃紧

Why it matters：全球最大电子代工厂掌门人对 AI 算力供应链瓶颈给出明确时间判断，是观察算力基础设施景气度的重要产业信号。

item.title: Meta Infrastructure Chief to Step Down After 17 Years, Amazon Veteran to Succeed
item.description:
Meta has confirmed that Santosh Janardhan, its long-serving infrastructure head and co-lead of engineering, will step down, with Dave Brown, a former Amazon executive who joined Meta earlier this year, taking over. Janardhan will stay through the transition as an advisor to Meta Compute before departing next year. The handover comes as Meta sharply scales AI data center investment, putting a new leader atop a critical infrastructure unit.

原文标题：Meta 基础设施负责人卸任 亚马逊老将接棒

Why it matters：Meta 在 AI 算力竞赛关键期更换基础设施掌舵人，涉及数据中心投资战略走向，值得关注。

item.title: Omdia Forecasts Global AI Software Revenue to Top $200 Billion This Year
item.description:
Omdia's latest forecast puts global AI software revenue above $200 billion in 2026, doubling 2024 levels, with generative AI revenue up 139% year over year. Over 2025-2031 the market is projected to grow at roughly 30% CAGR, while agentic AI leads at 104% CAGR and generative AI is expected to overtake predictive AI revenue by 2028.

原文标题：Omdia 预计今年全球 AI 软件收入突破 2000 亿美元

Why it matters：这是一份覆盖 AI 软件整体盘子与智能体增速的权威市场预测，为判断行业景气度与赛道结构变化提供量化锚点。

item.title: TrendForce Forecasts PC DRAM Prices to Climb 18% in Q4
item.description:
TrendForce forecasts PC DRAM contract prices to rise another 13-18% quarter-over-quarter in Q4 2026, with client SSDs up 0-5%. OEM memory inventories have climbed since Q3, prompting some vendors to renegotiate 2027 supply terms and trim procurement through Q1 2027.

原文标题：TrendForce 预测 PC 内存与 SSD 四季度再涨 18%

Why it matters：存储涨价直接推高 AI PC 与终端硬件成本，是算力供应链的重要价格信号。

item.title: CXMT Says Server Memory Demand Now Exceeds Half of Total Market
item.description:
CXMT VP Luo Xiaodong said at the IC Entrepreneurs Conference that AI compute demand has pushed memory into a stratified era, with servers now accounting for over 50% of memory demand and DRAM demand set to grow 21% annually from 2026 to 2030. The company expects DRAM shortages to persist and Q4 revenue to keep rising on strong server customer demand.

原文标题：长鑫科技：服务器内存需求占比已超 50%

Why it matters：国产 DRAM 龙头首次明确服务器内存需求占比过半，是观察 AI 算力对存储结构性拉动的一手产业信号。

item.title: Japan Weighs Penalties for AI Firms Over Frontier Model Risks
item.description:
Japan is advancing a regulatory overhaul that would oblige AI firms to meet safety obligations and allow the government to issue enforcement orders, with penalties for non-compliant companies after frontier AI incidents such as loss of control or cyberattacks. The full reform plan is expected by year-end, while the scope of covered firms, including US model developers, remains under discussion.

原文标题：日本拟立法处罚前沿 AI 失控企业

Why it matters：这是主要经济体首次明确以处罚手段约束前沿 AI 失控风险，标志 AI 监管从倡导转向强制执法。

item.title: SK Hynix HBM4 Yield Tops 70 Percent as Mass Production Race Heats Up
item.description:
SK Hynix's HBM4 yield has reportedly surpassed 70%, a level that could lift output by roughly 16.7% at equal production input versus 60%, seen as the key variable for mass-production competitiveness in next-gen high-bandwidth memory. Samsung is said to be near 80% and Micron is pushing hard, with early HBM4 yield and stable supply expected to shape future market share.

原文标题：SK 海力士 HBM4 良率突破 70% 加速量产竞赛

Why it matters：HBM4 良率是决定 AI 算力供给与成本的硬指标，头部三家厂商的良率竞赛直接影响下一代加速卡的产能节奏。

item.title: Runway Open-Sources 27B Robotics Model Praxis-1
item.description:
Runway released Praxis-1, an open-weight robotics control model built on a 27B-parameter video foundation model under Apache 2.0, runnable and fine-tunable on local hardware. Runway claims it completes robotic arm tasks 15.6x faster than a GPT-6 Astra-driven setup at 1/51 the per-task cost, leading the world-action-model category on the RoboLab-120 benchmark.

原文标题：Runway 开源 270 亿参数机器人模型 Praxis-1

Why it matters：视频预训练迁移到真实机器人控制并开放权重，是具身智能路线的重要节点。

item.title: Hygon Targets 2027 Mass Production of Next-Gen CPU to Match Global Peers
item.description:
Hygon Information general manager Sha Chaoqun said at the SSE International Investors Conference that the company expects to mass-produce its next-generation CPU next year with performance benchmarked against international peers, arguing compute infrastructure has shifted from single-chip to system-level competition. Its portfolio spans DCUs for LLM training, CPUs for AI data centers, and edge chips integrating CPU, GPU and NPU, under a sell-verify-develop cadence.

原文标题：海光信息预计明年量产新一代 CPU 对标国际水平

Why it matters：国产 x86 算力芯片厂商给出明确量产时间表，是观察国产 AI 算力供给节奏的重要信号。

item.title: SoftBank Leads $500M Round in Agile Robots at $8.5B Valuation
item.description:
Munich-based humanoid robot maker Agile Robots raised $500M led by SoftBank Group, with Nvidia, Hitachi and T.Capital participating, lifting its valuation to $8.5B and cumulative funding to roughly $2B. The capital will scale manufacturing and US expansion, with the company targeting about 2,000 humanoid units in 2026 and already testing systems at customers including Audi.

原文标题：软银领投 Agile Robots 5 亿美元融资 估值达 85 亿美元

Why it matters：软银领投的 5 亿美元大额融资叠加明确的人形机器人量产爬坡计划，是具身智能产业化的重要资本信号。

item.title: Foxconn Net Profit Jumps 30% on Surging AI Server Demand
item.description:
Foxconn posted record first-nine-month results for 2026, with revenue of NT$7.66 trillion and net profit of NT$187.417 billion, up 30% year on year, driven by booming AI server demand. The company said Vera Rubin server shipments are ramping and 800G switches plus CPO all-optical switches are on schedule for mass production, keeping its strong growth outlook intact.

原文标题：鸿海前三季净利 1874 亿新台币 同比增长 30%

Why it matters：全球最大 EMS 厂商的 AI 服务器业务放量节奏，是观察算力供应链景气度的关键指标。

item.title: ByteDance Volcengine Launches Seedance 2.5 Flash Video Model
item.description:
ByteDance's Volcengine has launched Seedance 2.5 Flash, a video generation model it says comes closest to the flagship Seedance 2.5 while doubling generation speed and cutting cost. At 720P, text-to-video and image-to-video generation costs about 0.99 yuan per second, roughly 34% less than the flagship. The model supports clips up to 30 seconds and accepts up to 10 images, 5 videos and 5 audio tracks per request at 480P or 720P, with the API arriving on Volcano Ark on November 15.

原文标题：字节发布 Seedance 2.5 flash 视频模型 生成速度翻倍

Why it matters：视频生成模型以速度翻倍、降价 34% 切入批量生产场景，是 AI 视频商业化落地的实质进展。

item.title: Chongqing Targets Over 100,000 Petaflops of Dispatchable AI Compute by 2028
item.description:
Chongqing has set a target of more than 100,000 petaflops of dispatchable intelligent computing capacity by 2028, alongside buildout of scheduling platforms and network infrastructure. It is one of the few explicit municipal-level AI compute targets in China, signaling a shift from isolated data centers toward cross-region schedulable capacity.

原文标题：重庆规划 2028 年可调度智算规模超 10 万 P

Why it matters：地方政府给出明确的智算规模量化目标，对关注国内算力供给与调度体系建设的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Vitaura Named to The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups
item.description:
Vitaura was named to The Information's 2026 list of the 50 Most Promising Startups, one of only six Asian companies selected. Its AURA CellOS models human cell behavior with a world model and is among the earlier human-cell AI models built on a joint embedding predictive architecture; the team placed second globally in the all-around track of the Arc Institute Virtual Cell Challenge and has a research collaboration with 10x Genomics.

原文标题：百曜科技入选 The Information 全球潜力 50 强

Why it matters：这是企业入选榜单的公关稿，但披露了 AIVC 方向的具体技术路线与竞赛、合作事实，对关注 AI for Science 的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Tongxin Intelligence Raises Hundreds of Millions for AGI Chip Prototype
item.description:
Tongxin Intelligence reportedly closed a funding round in the hundreds of millions of yuan to develop its first chip targeting AGI workloads. The chip is slated for prototype validation in December, still an early pre-tapeout stage with no disclosed architecture or performance figures.

原文标题：通芯智能完成数亿元融资 首款 AGI 芯片 12 月原型验证

item.title: Apple Details HomeView Person Recognition with On-Device Privacy Design
item.description:
Apple published a new blog post detailing how its HomeView smart home hub identifies up to six household members, using Center Stage camera and microphone inputs processed entirely inside Secure Exclaves. The main system receives only a conclusion of who is present, where, and with what confidence, while raw images and audio never leave the isolated enclave, tying biometric personalization to on-device privacy architecture.

原文标题：苹果揭秘 HomeView 识人流程 只传暗号不传照片

Why it matters：首次披露苹果家庭中枢的端侧生物识别与隔离区隐私架构，对关注端侧 AI 与隐私计算者有实质参考价值。

item.title: Samsung Breaks Ground on 46 Trillion Won HBM Packaging Plant
item.description:
Samsung Electronics has broken ground on a new HBM back-end advanced packaging facility at its Onyang complex in South Korea, comprising five production lines with a total investment of 46 trillion won (about $32 billion), including 40 trillion won for equipment. The plant, slated to start production in 2028 with 31,000 square meters of cleanroom, will substantially expand Samsung's HBM packaging capacity.

原文标题：三星投 46 万亿韩元建 HBM 先进封装产线

Why it matters：三星以 46 万亿韩元重注 HBM 先进封装产能，是 AI 算力供应链扩产的关键节点。

item.title: 美商务部拟新规 封堵中企经第三国租用 Blackwell
item.description:
美国商务部拟出台新规，要求新加坡、马来西亚、泰国、印尼、巴西、挪威、南非等国出口英伟达 Blackwell 及更新代芯片须申请许可证，并披露最终收货方与用途、接受持续监控。该规则同时针对远程算力租用与芯片走私两条路径，实质是将算力出口管制从货物贸易延伸至云租赁环节。

Why it matters：算力出口管制首次明确覆盖第三国数据中心租赁，直接影响中企海外训练算力供给路径。

item.title: 李彦宏称具身智能相当于 2016 年无人驾驶水平
item.description:
在百度世界 2026 大会上，李彦宏将当前具身智能的发展阶段类比为 2016 年前后的无人驾驶，认为其仍需长期技术积累。他同时强调无人驾驶是 AI 竞争不可或缺的一环，并披露萝卜快跑与神州租车合作推出全球唯一的无人车租车模式，已在海南运营超过一年。

Why it matters：行业领袖对具身智能发展阶段的公开判断，附带无人车商业化落地进展，具备一定行业参考价值。

item.title: 谷歌抢先发布 Gemini Decision 1 决策模型
item.description:
谷歌在 AIE CODE 活动上抢先 Anthropic 发布 Gemini Decision 1，这是一款校准过的多模态决策模型，支持最多 1000 个问题输入，每百万输入 token 定价 0.10 美元，端到端延迟约 200ms。此举标志着“决策模型”作为独立产品品类正式进入生产可用阶段，谷歌在与 Anthropic 的发布竞赛中取得先手。

Why it matters：谷歌抢先发布生产级决策模型，定价与延迟参数明确，是模型品类扩展的重要节点。

item.title: Claude 10 月访问量 12.53 亿次创历史新高
item.description:
Similarweb 数据显示，Claude 今年 10 月网站访问量约 12.53 亿次，环比增长 23.8%，同比增长 536.3%，成为全球第三大 AI 聊天机器人网站。该增长恰逢 Anthropic 筹备 IPO，但需注意该指标为网站访问次数而非独立用户数，且不含原生应用流量。

Why it matters：Claude 流量激增与 Anthropic IPO 进程叠加，是观察 AI 助手竞争格局与商业化的关键窗口。

item.title: 佐治亚居民起诉 OpenAI 与县政府 涉 200 亿美元数据中心
item.description:
佐治亚州居民依据该州反敲诈勒索法起诉 OpenAI 及县官员，指控双方在未公开的情况下秘密推进一座 200 亿美元数据中心项目，并寻求三倍损害赔偿。诉状称县开发机构负责人早在 2025 年 10 月即与 OpenAI 签署保密协议，比公开宣布提前约 9 个月，且以“Project Gateway”名义过会、跳过两次必要听证。

Why it matters：AI 算力基建扩张首次遭遇反敲诈勒索法诉讼，凸显数据中心落地中的程序合规与社区冲突风险。

item.title: System One 模型走红 工程师用它替代推理大模型
item.description:
在 AI Engineer Code Summit 上，System One 模型成为核心议题：这类非生成式模型直接输出结构化选择、分数或概率，速度与成本显著优于推理型大模型。TypeSafe AI 联合创始人 Diogo Almeida 发表主题演讲，他此前主导开发的 Jev 在两个月前发布后迅速成为该方向的代表产品，其核心卖点是解决以 LLM 为软件核心时的可靠性问题。

Why it matters：System One 模型作为推理大模型之外的新范式正在形成工程社区共识，Jev 的落地路径对开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic 或提前终止 SpaceX 算力租赁合作
item.description:
Anthropic 在更新版 S-1/A 招股文件中披露，与 SpaceX.AI 签署的算力协议累计支出上限约 1205 亿美元，覆盖约 32.5 万块英伟达 GPU，初始不可取消期限于 2027 年初结束。有会议纪要称该合同不会延续至 2027 年年中之后，马斯克回应称 SpaceX 乐意收回算力，但实际情况可能与外界猜测相反。

Why it matters：千亿美元级算力长约出现松动信号，牵动 GPU 供需与自建算力回流两条主线。
